brief: Preserve the newly identified official Ox Alpha source release, Z.ai GLM-5.3-Flash, from the verified zai-org Hugging Face repository under its MIT license. Check free disk space before downloading the 328 GB repository; if there is not at least 368 GB free, do not download. Preserve Qwen3.5 and port 8080 unchanged. Store Ox under ~/Models/Ox-Alpha/GLM-5.3-Flash, pin the source revision, record SHA-256 checksums, and retain provenance metadata. Attempt local inference verification only if a compatible local runner is already available; do not delete or replace any existing model.
